subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw add a public native subagent completion-routing contract named `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"`, and should it exist both per-spawn and as `agents.defaults.subagents.announceTarget`?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this adds a new model-facing tool/config API and changes how completion events wake parent sessions versus external channel delivery, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product surface.

options.title: Approve per-spawn plus config default
options.body: Add `announceTarget` to `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default it to current channel behavior, and route `parent` completions into the requester session with no direct channel announce.

options.title: Approve per-spawn only
options.body: Add only an explicit per-call override to reduce global config growth while still enabling orchestrator-controlled handoffs.

options.title: Decline native routing for now
options.body: Keep the current depth-based completion delivery model and leave users on explicit callback or suppression patterns while narrower related issues continue separately.

recommendation.title: Approve per-spawn plus config default
recommendation.body: Add `announceTarget` to `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default it to current channel behavior, and route `parent` completions into the requester session with no direct channel announce.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across sessions_spawn, subagent thread binding, announce delivery, and the docs for this exact surface.
